# Wave registries with multiple consumers

JavaScript programs and compact review reproductions exercise registry versions reaching distinct consumers and callable aliases.

[`finite-origins.js`](finite-origins.js) is the mutation template. Full reaching-registry baseline/alternate/heldout sources, callable-alias, branched, guarded, and consumer-heldout programs retain real consumption paths. [`pinned-origins.json`](pinned-origins.json) pins the expected source-specific origins.

Consumed by:

- [naming_wave_multi_consumer.rs](../../../naming_wave_multi_consumer.rs)

Each consumption uses its own live slot order. [`review-multi-declarator.js`](review-multi-declarator.js) and the dormant-ABI context derived from [`review-dormant-abi.js`](review-dormant-abi.js) are refusal controls; [`review-escaped-callable.js`](review-escaped-callable.js) and [`review-self-callee-argument.js`](review-self-callee-argument.js) both check that escape retains both factory origins at slot 0. Shared factories must not acquire an invented unique position.

Preserve complete source bytes and pinned identities. Keep callable/registry branches correlated, and do not erase overwritten, dormant, or escaped versions when simplifying a reproduction.

Read these as static source inputs; do not execute recovered JavaScript.
Next: [related fixture guide](../wave-named-transport/README.md) and the [program fixture overview](../README.md).
